note: Alberta Parks campground in the Battle River valley off Secondary Highway 855, with open and treed sites, a playground, horseshoe pitch and boat launch; 11 walk-in tent sites as well. Tap water runs only from the July long weekend to the September long weekend, and since August 5, 2026 a water main break has left the park without water until further notice; bring water. Exact cash or cheque only. --Claude
